label: Jun 6, 2026
headline: US busts India-linked H-1B fraud ring — 100,000+ fake degree certificates seized
summary: Federal authorities uncovered a major India-linked visa fraud operation, seizing over 100,000 fake degree certificates from institutions including Manav Bharti University. Degrees sold for as little as $1,400 were used to qualify for H-1B visas. ICE identified 10,000+ students linked to "highly suspect employers" through OPT. USCIS admitted it does not track degrees from flagged institutions — expect heightened credential scrutiny for Indian applicants.

label: Jun 4, 2026
headline: Bill introduced to end H-1B as green card pathway & eliminate OPT program
summary: Rep. Chip Roy (R-TX) introduced the "American White-Collar Worker Jobs Act of 2026" — would replace the H-1B lottery with wage-based selection, end H-1B as a route to permanent residency, eliminate the OPT program for foreign graduates, and require employers to prove no qualified Americans are available before hiring H-1B workers. Still a bill, not law, but signals escalating Congressional pressure on the program.

label: Jun 2, 2026
headline: USTravelDocs & CEAC hit by outages — scheduling and payments disrupted
summary: US visa processing websites including USTravelDocs.com and CEAC are experiencing significant technical issues, delaying interview bookings, fee payments, and document uploads. India is among the hardest-hit countries. State Dept working on fix, no timeline given. Applicants advised to retry after 24 hours.

label: Jun 2, 2026
headline: 200K+ H-1B applicants paid $100K each for 15-day processing — standard wait now 7.5 months
summary: DHS Secretary Mullin testified before Senate that of 286,000 H-1B applications in FY2026, over 200,000 paid $100,000 for expedited 15-day processing. Standard processing now takes 7.5 months. Senators pushing for exemptions for doctors and teachers in rural/underserved communities.

label: Jun 1, 2026
headline: US Embassy India warns: visa screening continues after issuance — violators face revocation & deportation
summary: @USAndIndia posted that screening does not stop once a visa is issued. Holders are continuously monitored for compliance with US laws and immigration rules — visas will be revoked and holders deported if found in violation. Part of broader enforcement posture alongside expanded social media vetting.

label: May 30, 2026
headline: DHS walks back Green Card return-home rule — now case-by-case
summary: After backlash to the May 23 directive, DHS clarifies most green card applicants will NOT be required to leave the US. Adjustment of status called 'extraordinary relief' but officers decide case-by-case — no blanket exit mandate.

label: May 27, 2026
headline: EB-2 India green card quota fully exhausted for FY2026
summary: All EB-2 immigrant visa numbers for India used up. Final Action Date retrogressed to Sep 2013. No new EB-2 green cards for Indians until FY2027 begins Oct 2026.

label: May 26, 2026
headline: Rubio freezes student visa appointments worldwide
summary: US State Department halts all new F-1 visa appointments. Indian fall enrollments already in freefall.

label: May 24, 2026
headline: Rubio launches "AppUS" — new America First visa scheduling tool
summary: Prioritises business professionals who strengthen US-India commercial ties. Announced during Rubio's first India visit as Secretary of State.

label: May 23, 2026
headline: Green Card applicants must return to home country to apply
summary: US government announces that those seeking a Green Card must now return to their home countries to file — a major shift affecting thousands of Indian applicants. (Update: DHS partially walked this back on May 30.)

label: May 12, 2026
headline: ICE launches nationwide crackdown on Day 1 CPT and OPT fraud
summary: ICE announced coordinated enforcement targeting schools, students, and employers involved in fraudulent CPT/OPT programs. Thousands of Indian professionals who used Day 1 CPT to maintain F-1 status between H-1B lottery attempts now face scrutiny — prior CPT use may affect pending H-1B petitions.

headline: Kolkata launches priority B1/B2 slots for parents 50+
summary: US Consulate Kolkata now offers priority visitor visa appointments for eligible Indian parents aged 50 and above visiting children in the US.

label: Dec 2025
headline: Social media screening expanded to employment visas
summary: Adds ~30 min per case, slashing daily appointment capacity by nearly half. Backlogs expected through Q2 2026.

label: Sep 2025
headline: Interview waiver eliminated for work & student visas
summary: H-1B, H-4, L-1, F-1, J-1, O-1 applicants no longer qualify for interview waiver. All must attend in-person interviews.
